title: Bahira
description: The eldest of our three duckling siblings, big sister to Bahgat and baby Zaghloul. Nothing ruffles her feathers, and she's happiest with a bit of water nearby.

title: ZouZou
description: A little bunny with big curious eyes and rosy cheeks. Put her anywhere and the whole corner suddenly feels softer.

title: Shawkat
description: A russet fox who knows exactly how clever he is, and yes, a little spoiled. Wherever he sits, mischief follows.

title: Shokreya
description: Forever halfway into a nap, and all the sweeter for it. She brightens up her spot quietly, no fuss at all.

title: Zaghloul
description: The baby of the duckling trio, still hatching out of his shell and brand new to everything. Bahira and Bahgat keep him tucked safely between them.

title: Bahgat
description: His name means “joy”, and he takes the job seriously. He's the sunny middle duckling of the trio, right between Bahira and little Zaghloul.

title: Bondoq
description: His name is Bondoq… always smiling and effortlessly spreading joy

title: Farawla
description: Cute without even trying, and always makes every corner feel a little brighter

title: Suzy
description: It won’t take up much space, but it’ll definitely catch your eye.

title: Bahloul
description: Bahloul always looks surprised, and no one knows what he’s seen

title: Semsem
